selection.rationale: Strategy-local MACE history demonstrates 100% convergence and 100% unique final geometries across all compositions at tiers 4 and 8, and across CrMnFeCoNi, CrMn2FeCoNi, and CrMnFe2CoNi at tier 16, whereas Cr2MnFeCoNi suffers elevated nonconvergence at tier 16 (only 3/11 converged across 4784ff60ab685a83, 7dd0fbff30845fcd, and 4c17b8e3c0b6681f). We therefore concentrate 27 samples evenly across the nine 100%-converging tier-16 actions and 30 samples across all twelve 100%-converging tier-8 actions—upweighting Cr2MnFeCoNi at tier 8 (12 samples) to preserve balanced compositional and perturbation diversity without wasting budget on nonconvergent Cr2MnFeCoNi tier-16 relaxations. Tier 4 receives 4 samples targeting the four previously unattempted perturbation-composition combinations, tier 32 receives 2 samples on a5236ad683fcb00b (the highest-converging tier-32 action at 2/3), and tier 64 is held to its minimum required count of 1 due to 0% convergence across all prior tier-64 runs.
